notes.title: Update on request
notes.content:
Hello everyone!ːsteamhappyː
Here is a small update that you requested from me
Added windowed mode (to switch enter the game and switch it in the settings)
Added keyboard support for two players. Just press any button on your keyboard instead of a gamepad.

notes.title: Game: Iron Disco
notes.content:
[h3]A porn parody of the famous action game is now available! Back in the 80s. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/b9a6fe50810925f3c8ac61ae0378e5b45c671fd2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/b1b8b8360890fc027b82e516beca349c27140d4f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Destroy the rebels, enjoy HD cutscenes [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/4c9fd3c4883b9353df81a8cfc9201b7ac7474f44.jpg[/img]
[h3]And do not forget to visit the headquarters in the game, there you will find surprises. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/0e87b11ae2df4412c8e54bfa32358e59a3198f18.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/1796050f9dca4af907c90b99ac4d51e80c19131e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/79e0d5104e08aa7ebee205917b1ec373e6e48797.jpg[/img]
[h3]A gamepad with Xinput (Xbox or Logitech) works best, but the keyboard can be played too. 
The menu contains settings for controlling gamepads and keyboard.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793163/7d6f156592438d6c9ea5400d3a756e9358306fd2.jpg[/img]
